professionalSummary: Staff Software Engineer for the observability platform of a cloud software company since 2022, setting the platform's technical direction across its ingestion, storage and query teams; senior software engineer on the storage team from 2018 to 2022.
experienceHighlights: Wrote the platform's technical strategy for 2023 and 2025 and the fourteen architecture decision records the three teams built against, all under my name in the platform's architecture repository.

Chaired the platform design review from 2022, with the review calendar and the review outcomes in the repository, and represented the platform in the company's technical steering group, where the steering group minutes record the platform items under my name.
Coached the five senior engineers across the three teams under the engineering coaching practice, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
Wrote the open questions section of each decision record and the boundary note of each design review, stating what was left undecided.
